name: NCAA D-III West Regional Cross Country Championships
where: Spokane Valley, WA · host Whitworth · The Course Spokane Valley
headline: NCAA D-III West Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: No. 15 Pomona-Pitzer won the men’s race with 40 points over No. 25 Claremont-Mudd-Scripps (85) and Colorado College (144), led by race winner Jefferson Wright in 24:08.1. No. 11 Pomona-Pitzer also won the women’s title with 65 points, ahead of No. 30 Trinity (Texas) (98) and No. 12 Claremont-Mudd-Scripps (102). No. 25 Colorado College’s Charlie Flint won the women’s race in 21:08.9.
